# Processes images embedded in PDFs. Must be enabled to extract images from PDFs if they are expanded.
# If enabled, OCR is applied to embedded images instead of the images generated by rendering each page.
# Sometimes images are fragmented in PDFs, resulting in cut-off words or lines. In this case, this option can be detrimental to OCR.
# Also, with this option, OCR of JBIG2 images in PDFs doesn't work because Tesseract does not support this format. 
processImagesInPDFs = true
